messages.content: Write an SMS conversation between a rural ND patient and Northline Care agent about a prescription refill issue, 4-8 texts, patient pt-1003, conversation 90.

SMS Conversation #90 — Patient pt-1003, Rural ND

Patient: Hey—ran out of my lisinopril. Need a new script but doc's clinic 90 min away. Pharmacy says they can't refill without doc contact.

Agent: Got it. Losing blood pressure meds is serious. I can't write scripts or push refills, but I can escalate you to our nurse to help coordinate with your doctor. Fair?

Patient: How long's the wait?

Agent: Median is 31 hours right now. I'll mark as urgent since you're already out. Want me to escalate?

Patient: Yeah do it. And can you log that I missed today's dose?

Agent: Logging it now and escalating to nurse. They'll try to reach you soon. I'll also set your next checkin for next week if that works?

Patient: Perfect. Appreciate you.

Agent: You got it. Escalation sent—hang tight. Next week we touch base.

theme: prescription refill needs a new script, pharmacy is far away
